## Overview

### Why

Vercel's build of the demo app failed on its imports from `@lovo/bones`. The package's `exports` map points the import at `dist/index.mjs`, and nothing had built `dist/` when `next build` ran.

### Behavior change

The demo's `build` script builds `@lovo/bones` first, then runs `next build`. The demo builds from a clean checkout, on Vercel and locally.

### Checks

A Vercel deployment of the demo app succeeded.

### Not covered

The script rebuilds the package on every demo build, even when `dist/` is current.

## Build the package before the demo

The demo's `build` script now runs the package's own `build` script through `pnpm --filter`. The docs app already builds the package this way.
